captures.label: healthy
captures.seen: Inconclusive selected-target conversion fixture. Two original zebra silhouettes with distinct striped legs; ordinary runner converted other zebra while selected original remained healthy100HP. Close overlaps multiple animals and clips heads; no clean moving-leg verdict from this fixture. All four panels inspected, including both high close images separately. Personally inspected all eight original-size panels in paired-zoom sheet. Courier face, green launcher and pale/red boots remain readable against dark grass. Wide views establish silhouette/readability, not fine wound pixels.
